whyItMatters: rand.Intn is predictable in go, so security values drawn from it can be guessed by an attacker.
actions: Replace rand.Intn with crypto/rand for tokens, nonces, salts, and secrets.
For remaining statistical uses, add a comment stating predictability is acceptable.
Re-run the scan and confirm every security draw uses the cryptographic generator.
verification: Rescan shows no rand.Intn feeding security values, and token prediction tests fail.
